en: Oh no! It's raining, and Grandpa has no umbrella! What should we do?
Listen! <SAW> once said: Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to people.
So let's be kind! Share your umbrella, and keep Grandpa dry!
Help carry the heavy bags. One, two, up we go!
Little brother is crying? Give him a big hug, and share your toy!
When we are kind to people, Allah is kind to us!
Who will you be kind to today? Tell your grown-up!
